fields.description: NOTE: product/goods cost is deliberately NOT a cost component here. Per critique M8 the supplier goods value (and CIF freight already embedded in the supplier PI) is EXCLUDED from the landed-cost build to avoid double capitalization — it is carried on the Purchase Receipt / Purchase Invoice, not re-added as a Landed Cost Voucher line.

fields.description: The carrier's or service provider's Purchase Invoice this cost line came from. Set automatically when a bill is linked to the import. A line is hand-typed only when BOTH this field and Import Expense are blank, and a document-sourced line supersedes a hand-typed line of the same component on the same container, so the same money is never capitalized twice.
fields.label: Purchase Invoice

fields.description: The Import Expense this cost line came from — the route taken by a cost paid in cash or from a bank account rather than billed on a supplier invoice. Set automatically when an expense is marked for landed cost. It is the second source field alongside Purchase Invoice; the two are mutually exclusive on a line, and either one marks the line as a real document rather than an operator's estimate.
fields.label: Import Expense

fields.description: Name of the Landed Cost Voucher that consumed this cost line. Set automatically; a blank value means the line is still available for a (multi-)LCV.
fields.label: LCV Ref
